purpose.en: Prove internal behavior without real Agent work.
purpose.zh: 通过确定性输入验证内部行为。

entry.en: Implementation and source review are complete

exit.en: Approved requirements map to actual implementation and valid checks.
exit.zh: 已批准需求与实际实现、有效检查一一对应。

failure.en: Repair scoped failures and reuse unaffected passing results.
failure.zh: 修复范围内失败，复用不受影响的通过结果。

boundary.en: Use actual DSL, state, scheduler and storage owners; simulate external boundaries only.
boundary.zh: 验证实际 DSL、状态机、调度和存储实现，仅替代外部边界。
